name: iam:PassRole on an IAM PATH-scoped role wildcard (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deployment/*) is NOT broad
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 3 over-correction guard. Closing the type-prefixed leading-wildcard fail-open (role/* = every role) must NOT start flagging PATH-scoped role wildcards. Here the identifier segment right after the concrete type head 'role' is 'deployment' (a concrete IAM path component), and only the trailing key is wildcarded (role/deployment/*), so the grant is confined to roles under the /deployment/ path - narrower than pass-any-role. Broadness is decided by the FIRST identifier segment after the type; a deeper wildcard behind a concrete path does not widen it back to the whole type. The engine MUST NOT emit WILDCARD-RESOURCE here.
rationale: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deployment/* matches only roles created under the IAM path /deployment/ in one account - a bounded subset, not every role. The resource-id is type='role' then identifier 'deployment/*': the identifier's first segment ('deployment') is a concrete path component, so this is a path-prefix scope, materially narrower than role/* (all roles). isBroadArnResource must test only the FIRST identifier segment after a concrete type head, so a trailing wildcard behind a concrete path stays quiet. Ref: AWS IAM role paths (arn:aws:iam::acct:role/path/RoleName); least-privilege path scoping.
